svg:
SƠ ĐỒ LỚP MỨC DOMAIN (DOMAIN CLASS DIAGRAM) – HỆ THỐNG BREWLITE
«entity / LoyaltyEntry» LoyaltyTransaction (LoyaltyEntry)
- id: UUID {PK} - userId: UUID {FK} - orderId: UUID {FK} - kind: LoyaltyKind {unique(orderId, kind)} - points: int (EARN > 0, REVERSE < 0) - createdAt: DateTime + createEarn(order: Order): LoyaltyEntry + createReverse(order: Order): LoyaltyEntry
Promotion
- id: UUID {PK} - code: string {unique} - type: PromotionType (FIXED | PERCENT) - value: int (> 0) - minSubtotal: int = 0 - maxDiscount: int [0..1] - maxUses: int [0..1] - usedCount: int = 0 (<= maxUses) - version: int = 0 - startsAt: DateTime / - endsAt: DateTime - active: boolean = true + isValidFor(subtotal: int, now: DateTime): boolean + calculateDiscount(subtotal: int): int + reserveUse(): void / + releaseUse(): void
«Catalog & Recipe» Product (kèm ProductSize, Topping, ProductIngredient)
- id: UUID {PK} - name: string - description: string - price: int (giá gốc size S >= 0) - imageUrl: string - version: int = 0 - active: boolean = true - createdAt: DateTime + sizes: ProductSize[1..*] (size: Size, price: int) + toppings: Topping[0..*] (name: string, price: int, active: boolean) + getSizePrice(size: Size): int + getRecipeRequirements(size: Size, qty: int): IngredientAmount[]
User
- id: UUID {PK} - email: string {unique} - passwordHash: string (bcrypt) - role: Role = CUSTOMER - loyaltyPoints: int = 0 (>= 0) - createdAt: DateTime + addLoyaltyPoints(pts: int): void + reverseLoyaltyPoints(pts: int): void + hasRole(role: Role): boolean
«Aggregate Root» Order
- id: UUID {PK} - code: string {unique} (BL-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX) - userId: UUID {FK} - promotionId: UUID [0..1] {FK} - promotionCode: string [0..1] - subtotal: int (>= 0) - discount: int = 0 (<= subtotal) - total: int (= subtotal - discount) - status: OrderStatus = PENDING - reservationStatus: ReservationStatus = HELD - version: int = 0 - createdAt: DateTime / - updatedAt: DateTime + assertTransition(next: OrderStatus): void + calculateTotals(): void + markPaid(): void / + cancel(): void
«Snapshot Line & Toppings» OrderItem (kèm OrderItemTopping)
- id: UUID {PK} - orderId: UUID {FK} - productId: UUID {FK} - productName: string (snapshot) - size: Size (S | M | L) - sizePrice: int (snapshot giá theo size) - unitPrice: int (= sizePrice + sum(topping.price)) - qty: int (1..99) - lineTotal: int (= unitPrice * qty) + toppings: OrderItemTopping[0..*] (toppingId, name, price) + calculateLineTotal(): int
«Recipe Inventory & Hold» Ingredient & OrderIngredientHold
- id: UUID {PK} - name: string - unit: IngredientUnit (GRAM | ML | PIECE) - stock: int (>= 0) - packageSize: int (> 0) / - packageLabel: string - version: int = 0 (Optimistic Lock) + hold: OrderIngredientHold (orderId, ingredientId, amount > 0) + reserve(amount: int, expectedVersion: int): void + release(amount: int): void / + consume(): void
«Payment & Idempotency» Payment (kèm IdempotencyRecord)
- id: UUID {PK} - orderId: UUID {FK} - idempotencyRecordId: UUID {unique, FK} - idempotencyKey: string (UUID) - amount: int (= Order.total) - method: PaymentMethod (WALLET | CARD) - status: PaymentStatus (SUCCEEDED | FAILED | REFUNDED) - isDuplicate: boolean = false - createdAt: DateTime / - updatedAt: DateTime + idempotency: IdempotencyRecord {unique(userId, scope, key)} + markSucceeded(): void + markFailed(): void / + markRefunded(): void
«enumeration» Role (UserRole) CUSTOMER STAFF (Barista) ADMIN (Mở rộng)
«enumeration» OrderStatus PENDING PAID PAYMENT_FAILED PREPARING READY COMPLETED CANCELLED
«enumeration» ReservationStatus HELD CONSUMED RELEASED
«enumeration» PromotionType FIXED PERCENT
«enumeration» LoyaltyKind EARN REVERSE
«enumeration» PaymentMethod WALLET CARD
«enumeration» PaymentStatus SUCCEEDED FAILED REFUNDED
«enumeration» Size (DrinkSize) S (100%) M (125%) L (150%)
«enumeration» IngredientUnit GRAM ML PIECE
1 0..* sở hữu sổ cái điểm ›
1 0..2 ‹ sinh / đảo điểm
1 0..* đặt đơn ›
0..* 0..1 áp dụng mã ›
(1..*) OrderItem -->
1 1..* chứa dòng món ›
0..* 1 tham chiếu món ›
0..* 1..*
(0..*) OrderIngredientHold -> (1) Ingredient -->
1 0..* giữ kho ›
1 0..* thanh toán bởi ›
